name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-05-09, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
